articles.title: CoinDesk 20 performance update: AAVE jumps 8.9%, leading index higher
articles.snippet: Solana (SOL) gained 4.5%, joining Aave (AAVE) as a top performer.

articles.title: Binance tells EU users it will no longer provide services after failing to secure MiCA license
articles.snippet: A day after withdrawing its MiCA license application in Greece and saying it is ‘not leaving Europe,’ Binance notified users across the European Union that it will suspend some services.

articles.title: Grant Cardone says he will keep buying bitcoin using real estate cash flows
articles.snippet: The real estate investor pitched his model as a treasury company backed by cash-flowing property rather than stock sales, framing the slide in bitcoin as a chance to accumulate.

articles.title: a16z-backed crypto firm rebrands, shifts focus to solving AI’s global copyright headache
articles.snippet: The startup formerly known as Story Protocol raised $140 million to secure internet rights and is now building an audit layer for data consent, licensing, and provenance for tech firms.

articles.title: Ethereum whale who shorted October 2025 crash opens $19.7M ETH short position
articles.snippet: Ether’s technical setup points to a potential drop to $1,375, a move that could lift one whale’s unrealized profit to $2.39 million.
